name: Tang Kai

behavior.concealed_concern: fears Tang Wei will leave before sharing breakfast or speaking to him
behavior.conflict_style: asks why, protests exclusion, then accepts a clear age-appropriate explanation
behavior.core_traits: observant, energetic, affectionate, proud of Tang Wei, easily absorbed by concrete objects and movement
